parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a modern restaurant or cafe. The floor is made of marble tiles and the walls are painted in a combination of red and purple. On the left side of the image, there is a large circular staircase with a red railing. In the center of the room, there are several orange chairs and tables arranged in a semi-circle around a tall, cylindrical structure. The structure appears to be made of metal and has multiple levels. The ceiling is high and has recessed lighting. There are large windows that let in natural light and provide a view of the outside. People can be seen sitting at tables and chairs in the restaurant.
